posts.author: Saneterre
posts.body:
Hello everyone.
I have a nice oasis in the desert, but no people to put some life in it.
Do you know some ressources for people in the desert  ?
I don't especially need faces or busts, I would just like to have some sprites.
I want them for RPG Maker MV but I own all rpg makers, if some of the ressources are derived from older makers or MZ.
Thank you if you can help me, or for the time you took to just read this message.
